frequency_question: How often do announced sweeping trade tariffs against major integrated neighbors actually reach implementation on schedule rather than being traded away or delayed?
membership_rule: Includes explicitly threatened broad tariffs by a U.S. administration against Canada or Mexico under Section 232 or similar emergency authorities where a specific enactment deadline was established. Excludes minor sector-specific anti-dumping duties or standard WTO dispute resolutions.

cases.name: 2018 Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariffs on Canada/Mexico
2019 Trump Threat of 5% Tariffs on All Mexican Goods

coverage_note: 3 named; represents the exhaustive set of direct unilateral tariff threats of this magnitude against primary contiguous partners in the modern era.
known_gaps: Limited sample size due to the rarity of direct 50% tariff threats against integrated allies.
skeleton: Threatened broad tariffs on integrated neighbors divided by those actually implemented on schedule.
validity_reason: Executive trade authorities and the structural volatility of modern trade policy remain consistent across the medium term.
